products.name: Propel DBM (Gel, Putty, Gel Plus, Putty Plus, Fibers)
products.ownership_history: Brand launched by NuVasive (expanded to Gel Plus/Putty Plus in September 2018); Globus Medical acquired NuVasive on September 1, 2023 (Globus FY2025 10-K). Gel and putty appear to be AlloSource-processed AlloFuse-type DBM sold under the NuVasive label (inferred from the shared 510(k) numbers in GUDID; not stated by either company).
products.composition: Human DBM in a poloxamer reverse-phase carrier (gel, putty); Plus versions add cancellous chips; Propel DBM Fibers are a separate fiber format.

regulatory.reference: K071849 (AlloFuse Gel and Putty, AlloSource, Dec 2008) and K103036 (AlloFuse Plus, AlloSource, Jan 2011) are the 510(k)s listed against Propel in FDA GUDID; no 510(k) in the name 'Propel' exists. Propel DBM Fibers: no 510(k) located (probably 361 HCT/P).
on_label_indications: Per the AlloFuse 510(k)s: orthopedic filler for gaps or voids not intrinsic to bony stability, packed into bony gaps as a bone graft extender (extremities, spine and pelvis) and as a bone void filler of the extremities and pelvis; AlloFuse Plus: autograft extender (extremities, posterolateral spine, pelvis) and void filler (extremities, pelvis).
Propel's own IFU was not retrieved; indications above are the predicate-label wording and are unverified for the Propel label.
